ex: 这座桥建得很牢固。
This bridge is solidly built.
我们要打下牢固的基础。
We must lay a solid foundation.
use: For structures and abstract things like 基础, 关系.

ex: 这真是一个神奇的地方。
This really is a magical place.
这种药的效果很神奇。
This medicine works wonders.
坐地铁可以节省时间。
Taking the subway saves time.
她很节省，从不乱花钱。
She's very thrifty and never wastes money.
use: For money, time, energy; close to 节约.

ex: 她工作非常细致。
She works very meticulously.
医生给我做了细致的检查。
The doctor gave me a thorough examination.
use: Careful about detail; 仔细 is close.

m: Like a **wheel** that **flows** round: to **take turns**.
ex: 我们轮流做饭。
We take turns cooking.
他们轮流照顾生病的妈妈。
They take turns looking after their sick mother.
use: Before a verb: 轮流 + verb.

ex: 双方终止了合同。
Both sides terminated the contract.
比赛因为大雨终止了。
The match was stopped because of heavy rain.
他用绳子把箱子绑好。
He tied up the box with rope.
这根绳子不够长。
This rope isn't long enough.
use: Measure word 根 or 条.

m: People who **walk** and are **arranged** in rows: **ranks**, a **formation**.
ex: 他也加入了志愿者的行列。
He joined the ranks of the volunteers.
士兵们排成整齐的行列。
The soldiers lined up in neat rows.
use: Mostly 加入……的行列 (join the ranks of). 行 is háng.

ex: 我的手机电池没电了。
My phone battery is dead.
遥控器要换电池了。
The remote control needs new batteries.
use: Measure word 节 (cell) or 块; 充电 = charge.

m: The **beauty** and **power** of how you hold your body: **posture**.
ex: 写字的时候姿势要正确。
Keep a correct posture when writing.
他换了一个舒服的姿势。
He shifted to a more comfortable position.
use: Body position; 姿态 is more about attitude.

ex: 夜里，四周一片寂静。
At night, everything around was silent.
寂静的山谷里只有鸟叫声。
In the silent valley there's only birdsong.

m: **Calculate** and **compare** every detail: to **haggle**, to fuss about.
ex: 他从不计较个人得失。
He never worries about personal gain or loss.
别跟小孩子计较。
Don't get worked up over what a child did.
use: Often negative: 别计较, 不计较.

ex: 他向往大都市的生活。
He longs for big-city life.
香港是一个国际化都市。
Hong Kong is an international city.
use: More stylish than 城市; 大都市 = metropolis.

m: Lost in a **vast** blur, like **that**: **blankly**, at a loss.
ex: 他茫然地看着我。
He looked at me blankly.
毕业后我对未来感到茫然。
After graduating I felt lost about the future.
use: Bewildered, not knowing what to do.

ex: 听到这个消息，我很难过。
I was very sad to hear the news.
别难过了，一切都会好的。
Don't be sad; everything will be fine.
use: Mostly sadness; 难受 is more physical.

ex: 每天刷牙保持口腔健康。
Brush your teeth daily to keep your mouth healthy.
他在医院的口腔科工作。
He works in the hospital's dental department.
use: Medical term; 口腔科 = dental department.

m: A **person** in the eyes of the **law**: a **legal person**.
ex: 他是这家公司的法人。
He is the legal representative of this company.
公司是一个法人。
A company is a legal person.
use: Legal term; 法人代表 = legal representative.

ex: 每个人都有言论自由。
Everyone has freedom of speech.
网上有很多错误的言论。
There are many false statements online.
use: 言论自由 = freedom of speech.

ex: 他努力压制心里的愤怒。
He tried hard to hold back his anger.
领导不应该压制不同的意见。
Leaders shouldn't suppress different opinions.

m: **Punish** with a **sum** of money: to **fine**; a fine.
ex: 闯红灯要罚款。
You get fined for running a red light.
他交了二百块罚款。
He paid a two-hundred-yuan fine.
use: 罚款 + amount: 罚款五百元. 罚 alone means to punish.

ex: 我奶奶有点迷信。
My grandma is a bit superstitious.
不要迷信专家的话。
Don't blindly trust what experts say.
use: Also "blind faith in": 迷信 + person or thing.

ex: 病人需要隔离治疗。
The patient needs to be treated in isolation.
回国后他被隔离了十四天。
After returning home he was quarantined for fourteen days.
我们乘坐飞机去上海。
We're flying to Shanghai.
乘坐地铁请排队。
Please queue when taking the subway.
use: Formal for 坐; used in announcements.

ex: 这些菜很可口。
These dishes are delicious.
妈妈做了一桌可口的饭菜。
Mum made a table of delicious food.
我今天要加班。
I have to work overtime today.
他昨天加班到晚上十点。
He worked late until ten last night.
他是我的得力助手。
He's my right-hand man.
我需要一个助手。
I need an assistant.
王子和公主幸福地生活在一起。
The prince and princess lived happily together.
他像个王子一样被照顾着。
He's looked after like a prince.
use: Common in fairy tales; 公主 = princess.

ex: 他抛弃了自己的家庭。
He abandoned his family.
我们应该抛弃旧观念。
We should discard old ideas.
use: People, things or ideas; strong word.

ex: 请按照这个格式写报告。
Please write the report in this format.
这个文件的格式不对。
This file's format is wrong.
我对自己的行为感到很惭愧。
I feel ashamed of my behaviour.
说来惭愧，我还不会游泳。
I'm embarrassed to say I still can't swim.
use: Milder than 羞耻; often modest self-criticism.

ex: 我很羡慕你有这么好的工作。
I really envy you having such a good job.
大家都羡慕他们的感情。
Everyone envies their relationship.
use: Friendly envy; 嫉妒 is jealous and negative.

ex: 他因为贿赂官员被抓了。
He was arrested for bribing officials.
他拒绝接受贿赂。
He refused to take bribes.

m: Your look **congeals** as you **look**: to **gaze at**.
ex: 她凝视着窗外的大海。
She gazed at the sea outside the window.
他们深情地凝视着对方。
They gazed tenderly at each other.

m: **Print** it and let it **climb** onto the page: to **publish** in a paper.
ex: 报纸上刊登了这条新闻。
The newspaper carried this story.
他的文章刊登在杂志上。
His article was published in a magazine.

m: The **straight** (first) **moon**: the **first month of the lunar year**.
ex: 正月十五是元宵节。
The fifteenth of the first lunar month is the Lantern Festival.
我们正月初一去拜年。
On the first day of the lunar year we pay New Year visits.
他们在山里发现了一个洞穴。
They found a cave in the mountains.
古人曾经住在洞穴里。
Ancient people once lived in caves.
他常常想起往事。
He often thinks back on the past.
这些往事我永远不会忘记。
I will never forget these memories.
use: Emotional; 回忆往事 = recall the past.

ex: 我们坐轮船去了上海。
We took a ship to Shanghai.
港口停着很多轮船。
Many ships are moored in the harbour.
use: Measure word 艘 or 条.

ex: 这是今年最热门的电影。
This is the hottest film this year.
计算机是热门专业。
Computer science is a popular major.

m: The **farming** calendar you **experience** the year by: the **lunar calendar**.
ex: 春节是农历新年。
Spring Festival is the lunar New Year.
我的生日按农历算是八月十五。
By the lunar calendar my birthday is the fifteenth of the eighth month.
我姐姐是护士。
My older sister is a nurse.
护士给我打了一针。
The nurse gave me an injection.
use: 士 is neutral tone in speech; 护士长 = head nurse.

ex: 这件事请你保密。
Please keep this a secret.
他的工资是保密的。
His salary is confidential.
use: 对 + someone + 保密 = keep from someone.

ex: 我们去喝杯啤酒吧。
Let's go for a beer.
冰箱里有几瓶啤酒。
There are a few bottles of beer in the fridge.
use: Measure word 瓶, 杯, 罐 (can).

m: **Arrange in order** like a **squadron**: to **line up**, queue.
ex: 请大家排队上车。
Please queue to board.
我排队排了半个小时才买到票。
I queued for half an hour to get a ticket.
请给我一份书面报告。
Please give me a written report.
这是书面语，口语不常说。
This is written language, not often used in speech.
use: 书面语 = written language; opposite 口头.

ex: 右边那个是我的座位。
The one on the right is my seat.
邮局在银行的右边。
The post office is to the right of the bank.

m: **Bear** and **bear** some more: to **endure**, be patient.
ex: 我已经忍耐到极限了。
I've reached the limit of my patience.
再忍耐一下，快到了。
Hold on a bit longer, we're almost there.
use: 忍耐 is about patience; 忍受 about enduring pain.

ex: 他慌忙跑出门去。
He rushed out the door in a hurry.
听到电话，她慌忙站了起来。
Hearing the phone, she stood up hastily.
use: Usually before verbs, describing flustered action.

ex: 侵略者掠夺了很多财富。
The invaders plundered great wealth.
不能掠夺自然资源。
We must not plunder natural resources.
他和小偷搏斗了起来。
He started fighting with the thief.
他们在海上和风浪搏斗。
They battled the wind and waves at sea.
use: Physical struggle with people, animals or nature.

m: **Not** **can** do anything, **what** to do?: **no way out**.
ex: 他无可奈何地摇了摇头。
He shook his head helplessly.
下大雨了，我们也无可奈何。
It's pouring, and there's nothing we can do about it.
use: 无可奈何地 + verb; helpless resignation.

ex: 我们住在火车站旁边的宾馆。
We're staying at the hotel next to the station.
这家宾馆很干净。
This hotel is very clean.
use: Measure word 家; close to 酒店, 饭店.

ex: 能认识你，我很幸运。
I'm lucky to have met you.
他是个幸运的人。
He's a lucky person.
好，就这个价格，成交！
OK, at this price, it's a deal!
这套房子上个月成交了。
This flat was sold last month.

m: **Go and return** through the **system** again: to **copy**.
ex: 请把这个文件复制一份。
Please make a copy of this file.
成功的经验很难复制。
Success is hard to replicate.
诸位，请安静一下。
Everyone, please be quiet for a moment.
感谢诸位的到来。
Thank you all for coming.
use: Formal address to a group; 大家 is everyday.

ex: 黎明前是最黑暗的时候。
It's darkest before the dawn.
他们黎明时出发了。
They set off at daybreak.

m: Can **not** bear to **give it up**: to **hate to part with**.
ex: 我舍不得离开这里。
I hate to leave this place.
这件衣服太贵了，我舍不得买。
This garment is too expensive; I can't bring myself to buy it.
use: Opposite 舍得. Also for spending money.

m: The **suburbs** **area**: the **suburbs**; also a district name.
ex: 他们住在郊区。
They live in the suburbs.
周末我们去郊区爬山。
At the weekend we go hiking outside the city.
use: Also 郊区, a district name in Tongling.

m: Keep it **secret** and **conceal it from** others: to **hide**.
ex: 你不要对我隐瞒什么。
Don't hide anything from me.
他隐瞒了自己的真实年龄。
He concealed his real age.
我们在楼下的餐厅吃饭。
We eat in the restaurant downstairs.
这家餐厅的菜很好吃。
The food in this restaurant is delicious.
那个国家局势很动荡。
The situation in that country is very unstable.
他经历过动荡的年代。
He lived through turbulent times.
博物馆里陈列着很多文物。
Many relics are on display in the museum.
商店把新货陈列在门口。
The shop displays new stock by the door.
他等得不耐烦了。
He got tired of waiting.
她不耐烦地看了看表。
She glanced at her watch impatiently.
use: 等得不耐烦 = grow impatient waiting.

ex: 这里的气氛让人感到压抑。
The atmosphere here feels oppressive.
不要压抑自己的感情。
Don't bottle up your feelings.
学生们都在教室里。
The students are all in the classroom.
我们的教室在三楼。
Our classroom is on the third floor.
use: Measure word 间 or 个.

ex: 我买了一条新裤子。
I bought a new pair of trousers.
这条裤子太长了。
These trousers are too long.
两国领导人进行了会晤。
The two countries' leaders held talks.
总统将在明天会晤外国客人。
The president will meet foreign guests tomorrow.
use: Formal, diplomatic; 见面 is everyday.

ex: 他挺起胸膛走了进去。
He walked in with his chest out.
心在胸膛里跳得很快。
My heart was beating fast in my chest.
use: Literary; 挺起胸膛 = hold one's head high.

ex: 他小时候因为事故残疾了。
He was disabled in an accident as a child.
这里有残疾人专用的厕所。
There's an accessible toilet here.
use: 残疾人 = disabled person; 残障 is a newer, gentler word.

ex: 他无偿献血已经十年了。
He has donated blood for free for ten years.
我们无偿为老人提供帮助。
We help the elderly free of charge.
老师让我们写一篇作文。
The teacher asked us to write an essay.
她的作文写得很好。
She writes very good essays.
use: Measure word 篇; mainly student essays.

ex: 导游带我们参观了故宫。
The guide took us round the Forbidden City.
我想当一名导游。
I want to be a tour guide.
use: Also a verb, "to guide a tour".

ex: 我们总共花了五百块。
We spent five hundred yuan in total.
这本书总共有十章。
This book has ten chapters in all.
政府想振兴农村经济。
The government wants to revitalize the rural economy.
他们努力振兴中华。
They strive to revitalize China.

m: **Not** able to **name** **its** **wonder**: **baffling**, without rhyme or reason.
ex: 他莫名其妙地生气了。
He got angry for no reason at all.
这件事真是莫名其妙。
This is utterly baffling.
use: Very common in speech; also 莫名其妙！ = What on earth?

ex: 他为成功打下了坚实的基础。
He laid a solid foundation for success.
地面很坚实。
The ground is firm.
他冷得发抖。
He was shaking with cold.
她害怕得浑身发抖。
She was trembling all over with fear.
use: Common with 冷得, 害怕得.

m: **Strive** with all your **power**: to **work hard for**.
ex: 我们力争提前完成任务。
We're working hard to finish the task early.
他力争在比赛中拿第一。
He is doing his utmost to win first place.
学校要以学生为导向。
Schools should be student-oriented.
媒体有舆论导向的作用。
The media steers public opinion.
警察晚上在街上巡逻。
The police patrol the streets at night.
保安每两个小时巡逻一次。
The guards patrol every two hours.

m: The **year** **level** you're in: a **grade**, a **year** at school.
ex: 我儿子上三年级。
My son is in third grade.
你几年级了？
What year are you in?
use: Number + 年级; also for university years.

ex: 下雨了，他照样去跑步。
It rained, but he still went running as usual.
没有你，我们照样能做好。
We can still do it well without you.

m: From the **end** of one **year**: **all year round**.
ex: 山顶终年积雪。
The mountaintop is covered with snow all year round.
这里终年温暖。
It's warm here all year long.
use: Literary; also a person's age at death.

ex: 天冷了，盖厚一点的被子。
It's cold, use a thicker quilt.
起床后要叠被子。
Fold your quilt after getting up.
use: Measure word 床 or 条.

ex: 周末你打算做什么？
What are you planning to do at the weekend?
我们周末去爬山吧。
Let's go hiking at the weekend.
use: No 在 needed: 周末去.

ex: 这条路很平坦。
This road is very smooth.
人生的道路不总是平坦的。
Life's road isn't always smooth.

m: **Open to view** and **open** wide: to **open wide**.
ex: 大门敞开着。
The front door is wide open.
今天的饭菜你敞开吃吧。
Eat as much as you like today.
use: 敞开心扉 = open your heart.

ex: 新娘今天真漂亮。
The bride looks beautiful today.
新郎和新娘一起敬酒。
The groom and bride toast together.
他假装没看见我。
He pretended not to see me.
别假装睡觉了，起来吧。
Stop pretending to sleep; get up.
他倡议大家少开车。
He proposed that everyone drive less.
学校发出了节约用水的倡议。
The school issued a call to save water.
他能熟练地使用电脑。
He uses the computer skilfully.
她是一位熟练的工人。
She is a skilled worker.
use: Skills from practice; 熟悉 = familiar.

ex: 他买了一些国家债券。
He bought some government bonds.
公司发行了新的债券。
The company issued new bonds.
我们明天一早动身。
We set off first thing tomorrow.
你什么时候动身去北京？
When are you leaving for Beijing?
use: Before a trip; close to 出发.

m: A **sweet** **heart** about it: to be **willing**, resigned.
ex: 输了比赛，他不甘心。
He lost the match and won't accept it.
她甘心为家庭付出一切。
She's willing to give everything for her family.
飞机安全降落了。
The plane landed safely.
飞机将在十分钟后降落。
The plane will land in ten minutes.
她的容貌很美。
She has beautiful features.
不要以容貌判断一个人。
Don't judge a person by their looks.
假使明天下雨，我们就不去了。
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
假使没有你，我早就放弃了。
If it weren't for you, I'd have given up long ago.
她是一个很有爱心的人。
She is a very caring person.
大家献出爱心，帮助灾区。
Everyone showed their kindness and helped the disaster area.

m: **Turn** and **turn** it back: to **reverse**, turn around.
ex: 他们在下半场扭转了局面。
They turned the game around in the second half.
我们必须扭转这种情况。
We must reverse this situation.
我只看到了他的侧面。
I only saw him from the side.
这件事从侧面说明了问题。
This sheds indirect light on the problem.

m: **Shake** until things **dazzle** and blur: to **rock**, to **sway**.
ex: 船在海上摇晃得很厉害。
The boat rocked badly at sea.
他喝醉了，走路摇摇晃晃的。
He's drunk and staggering.
邻居们都很热心。
The neighbours are all very helpful.
他热心地帮我找到了路。
He kindly helped me find the way.

m: **Transfer** things until they are in **harmony**: to **reconcile**, harmonious.
ex: 他想调和两个人的矛盾。
He wants to patch up the quarrel between the two.
这幅画的颜色很调和。
The colours in this painting are well balanced.
use: 调 is tiáo; for conflicts, flavours, colours.

ex: 他的预言成真了。
His prediction came true.
没有人能预言未来。
No one can predict the future.

m: Get to the **essence** and **go through** it all: to **master**.
ex: 他精通三种语言。
He is fluent in three languages.
她精通电脑。
She's an expert with computers.
use: Stronger than 熟悉; takes a subject or skill.

m: **Arrange** them out and **blame** them: to **exclude**, reject.
ex: 他被同学排斥。
He was shunned by his classmates.
不要排斥新的想法。
Don't reject new ideas.
这个房间很舒适。
This room is very comfortable.
我想过舒适的生活。
I want to live a comfortable life.
use: Slightly formal; 舒服 is everyday.

ex: 会议结束，大家解散吧。
The meeting's over; everyone can go.
这个乐队去年解散了。
This band broke up last year.
她是一个善良的女孩。
She is a kind-hearted girl.
他心地善良，大家都喜欢他。
He has a good heart; everyone likes him.
每个人都有弱点。
Everyone has weaknesses.
他的弱点是太容易相信别人。
His weakness is trusting people too easily.

m: **No** place **from** which to start: having **no way to**.
ex: 我无从知道他在哪里。
I have no way of knowing where he is.
问题太多，我不知从何说起，也无从下手。
There are so many problems, I don't know where to begin or how to tackle them.
use: Written; before a verb: 无从下手, 无从知道.

ex: 我每天晚上写日记。
I write in my diary every night.
她偷看了我的日记。
She secretly read my diary.
use: Measure word 本 or 篇; 写日记 = keep a diary.

ex: 这个官员因为贪污被抓了。
This official was arrested for corruption.
他贪污了一百万。
He embezzled a million yuan.
遇到危险时要保持镇定。
Stay calm when facing danger.
他镇定地回答了问题。
He calmly answered the question.
比赛的胜负还很难说。
The outcome of the match is still hard to call.
胜负不重要，重在参加。
Winning or losing doesn't matter; taking part does.
use: 一决胜负 = decide the winner.

ex: 这个组织已经解体了。
This organization has broken up.
飞机在空中解体了。
The plane broke apart in mid-air.
两国元首进行了会谈。
The two heads of state held talks.
他是这个国家的元首。
He is the head of state of this country.
妈妈给我做了一件新衣裳。
Mum made me some new clothes.
天冷了，多穿点衣裳。
It's cold, put on more clothes.
use: Spoken, a bit old-fashioned; 衣服 is standard.

ex: 他胡乱吃了几口就走了。
He gulped down a few bites and left.
不要胡乱花钱。
Don't spend money carelessly.
use: Before verbs: 胡乱写, 胡乱猜.

ex: 他常年在外地工作。
He works away from home all year round.
这座山常年有雪。
This mountain has snow all year round.
这家饭店的菜分量很足。
This restaurant gives generous portions.
他的话很有分量。
His words carry a lot of weight.
use: Portions of food; also importance. Read fènliang.

m: **Hinder** and **hinder**: to **obstruct**, to get in the way.
ex: 你的车妨碍交通了。
Your car is blocking traffic.
我不想妨碍你工作。
I don't want to disturb your work.
按照惯例，周末不上班。
As usual, there's no work at weekends.
这是国际惯例。
This is international practice.
use: 按照惯例 = as is customary.

m: **Return** everything and **receive** it into one: to **sum up**.
ex: 请归纳一下这篇文章的主要内容。
Please sum up the main points of this text.
他把问题归纳成三点。
He summed up the problems in three points.
这个盒子做得很精致。
This box is exquisitely made.
她家的装修很精致。
Her home is finely decorated.
这个项目依托大学的技术。
This project relies on the university's technology.
他失去了生活的依托。
He lost the thing he relied on in life.
他再三向我道歉。
He apologized to me again and again.
我考虑再三，还是决定去。
After thinking it over many times, I decided to go.
use: Before or after verbs: 再三考虑, 考虑再三.

ex: 他穿上军装很威风。
He looks very impressive in uniform.
不要在别人面前耍威风。
Don't throw your weight around in front of others.
他承包了这片果园。
He contracted to run this orchard.
这个工程由一家公司承包。
This project is contracted to one company.

m: **See** and **gaze** at someone you care about: to **visit**.
ex: 周末我去医院看望奶奶。
At the weekend I'm visiting Grandma in hospital.
谢谢你来看望我。
Thank you for coming to see me.
use: For visiting people, often the sick or elderly.

ex: 他穿上新衣服，很神气。
He looks very smart in his new clothes.
别那么神气，你还没赢呢。
Don't be so cocky, you haven't won yet.
他吃坏了肚子，一直呕吐。
He ate something bad and keeps vomiting.
坐船让我想呕吐。
Boats make me want to throw up.
use: Formal or medical; 吐 is everyday.

ex: 这是这个问题固有的缺点。
This is an inherent flaw in the problem.
我们要改变固有的想法。
We need to change our ingrained ideas.
父母总为孩子操心。
Parents always worry about their children.
这件事你别操心了。
Don't worry yourself about this.

m: **Gaze** and **face upward** with respect: to **pay respects** to.
ex: 我们去瞻仰了烈士纪念碑。
We went to pay our respects at the martyrs' monument.
很多人来这里瞻仰伟人。
Many people come here to honour the great man.
use: Formal; for monuments, remains, great people.

ex: 我的体力已经到极限了。
I've reached the limit of my strength.
他喜欢极限运动。
He loves extreme sports.

m: How far you can **look** across the **field**: **field of view**, outlook.
ex: 山顶的视野很好。
The view from the hilltop is great.
读书可以开阔视野。
Reading broadens your horizons.
use: 开阔视野 = broaden one's horizons.

ex: 请把剪刀递给我。
Please pass me the scissors.
这把剪刀不太快。
These scissors aren't very sharp.
他每天都很忙碌。
He's busy every day.
忙碌了一天，终于可以休息了。
After a busy day I can finally rest.
没有许可，不能进入。
No entry without permission.
如果时间许可，我们去看看。
Time permitting, let's go and take a look.
我爸爸血压有点高。
My dad's blood pressure is a bit high.
医生给我量了血压。
The doctor took my blood pressure.

m: **Bore through** and **exceed** the border: to **pass through**, to cross.
ex: 他们穿越了沙漠。
They crossed the desert.
这条路穿越整个城市。
This road runs right across the city.
use: Also time travel in fiction: 穿越剧.

ex: 他对朋友很慷慨。
He is very generous to his friends.
老板慷慨地给大家发了奖金。
The boss generously gave everyone a bonus.
他被几个流氓打了。
He was beaten up by some thugs.
别像个流氓一样说话。
Don't talk like a thug.

m: **Hate** that you can **not** do it: to be **itching to**.
ex: 我恨不得马上飞回家。
I wish I could fly home right now.
他恨不得把所有的书都买下来。
He's itching to buy every single book.
use: Followed by a wish, often exaggerated.

m: The **head** of the **mirror** (lens): a camera **lens**, a **shot**.
ex: 他对着镜头笑了笑。
He smiled at the camera.
这部电影有很多感人的镜头。
This film has many moving scenes.

m: Go back to the **former** state and **show understanding**: to **forgive**.
ex: 请原谅我的错误。
Please forgive my mistake.
我永远不会原谅他。
I will never forgive him.
use: Also polite: 请原谅 = excuse me.

ex: 他是一个很有野心的人。
He is a very ambitious man.
他的野心太大了。
His ambitions are far too great.
use: Often negative; 雄心 is positive.

ex: 山上有一座古老的城堡。
There's an ancient castle on the hill.
孩子们在沙滩上堆了一个城堡。
The children built a sandcastle on the beach.
啤酒上有一层泡沫。
There's a layer of foam on the beer.
很多人担心房地产泡沫。
Many people worry about a property bubble.
老师赞扬了他的努力。
The teacher praised his hard work.
他的行为得到了大家的赞扬。
His conduct won everyone's praise.
他有崇高的理想。
He has lofty ideals.
医生是一个崇高的职业。
Being a doctor is a noble profession.
他是一个很务实的人。
He's a very practical person.
我们要务实，不要说空话。
We should be practical and not talk empty words.
use: Praise word; opposite of 务虚.

m: A sound loan from "humour": **remote** and **silent** wit, **humorous**.
ex: 我们老师很幽默。
Our teacher is very funny.
他说话很有幽默感。
He has a good sense of humour.
他喜欢看推理小说。
He likes reading detective novels.
根据推理，凶手就在我们中间。
By reasoning, the culprit is among us.
渔民们一早就出海了。
The fishermen went out to sea early in the morning.
这个村子住的都是渔民。
Everyone in this village is a fisherman.
太热了，开空调吧。
It's too hot, turn on the air conditioning.
这个房间没有空调。
This room has no air conditioning.
use: Measure word 台; 开/关空调.

ex: 他在纸上画了一个三角。
He drew a triangle on the paper.
这块蛋糕切成了三角形。
This cake was cut into triangles.
use: 三角形 is the usual word for the shape.

m: The **neighbour** who **occupies** the next house: a **neighbour**.
ex: 我们的邻居很友好。
Our neighbours are very friendly.
我和他是邻居。
He and I are neighbours.
请列举三个例子。
Please give three examples.
他列举了很多理由。
He listed many reasons.

m: **Grab** it **tight**: to **make the most of**, hurry.
ex: 我们要抓紧时间。
We need to make the most of our time.
抓紧扶手，别摔倒了。
Hold on tight to the rail so you don't fall.
use: 抓紧时间 = hurry up, lose no time.

ex: 他的眉毛很浓。
He has thick eyebrows.
她皱了皱眉毛。
She knitted her brows.
use: Measure word 根 (one hair) or 道.

ex: 这个办法可行吗？
Will this method work?
我觉得这个计划不太可行。
I don't think this plan is very feasible.
南方的天气很潮湿。
The weather in the south is very humid.
地下室太潮湿了。
The basement is too damp.

m: **Startle** someone and make them **move**: to **alarm**, to disturb.
ex: 别惊动他，让他睡吧。
Don't disturb him; let him sleep.
这件事惊动了警察。
This incident brought in the police.
use: Causing a stir; often 别惊动.

m: **Fix** it until it **returns** to how it was: to **restore**.
ex: 工人们正在修复这座古桥。
The workers are restoring this ancient bridge.
他们想修复两人的关系。
They want to repair their relationship.
这座房子非常坚固。
This house is very sturdy.
这个箱子很坚固。
This box is very solid.
use: For physical objects; 牢固 also for abstract things.

ex: 我终于说服了爸爸。
I finally persuaded my dad.
你的理由不能说服我。
Your reasons don't convince me.
赌博是违法的。
Gambling is illegal.
他因为赌博输光了钱。
He lost all his money gambling.
屋子里弥漫着饭菜的香味。
The room is filled with the smell of cooking.
早上山里弥漫着大雾。
In the morning thick fog fills the hills.
狗对主人很忠诚。
Dogs are very loyal to their owners.
他对公司非常忠诚。
He is very loyal to the company.
我想去海边学潜水。
I want to learn to dive at the seaside.
他在群里一直潜水，从不说话。
He always lurks in the group chat and never speaks.
公园里的花都盛开了。
The flowers in the park are in full bloom.
春天，樱花盛开。
In spring the cherry blossoms are in full bloom.
网络是一种重要的媒介。
The internet is an important medium.
蚊子是传播疾病的媒介。
Mosquitoes are carriers of disease.
use: 媒体 = the media; 媒介 is any medium.

ex: 这个体育馆可以容纳一万人。
This stadium can hold ten thousand people.
这个房间容纳不了这么多人。
This room can't hold so many people.
去那里起码要两个小时。
It takes at least two hours to get there.
这是最起码的礼貌。
This is the most basic courtesy.
use: Spoken; 最起码 = the bare minimum.

m: **Welcome** it to your **face**: **head-on**, in your face.
ex: 一辆车迎面开过来。
A car came towards us head-on.
一阵冷风迎面吹来。
A cold wind blew right in my face.
use: Before verbs of coming: 迎面走来.

m: Something **within** that **introduces** two sides: an **intermediary**, agent.
ex: 我们通过中介租了房子。
We rented the flat through an agent.
这家中介收费很高。
This agency charges high fees.
典礼的气氛很庄重。
The ceremony had a solemn atmosphere.
他穿着一身庄重的西装。
He wore a sober suit.

m: **Feel** a chill **emit** from you: to **catch cold**; a **cold**.
ex: 我感冒了，头很疼。
I've caught a cold and have a bad headache.
多穿点衣服，别感冒了。
Put on more clothes so you don't catch cold.
use: Also slang: 不感冒 = not interested.

ex: 她在家伺候生病的婆婆。
She stays home to look after her sick mother-in-law.
这个孩子真难伺候。
This child is really hard to please.
use: Spoken; read cìhou. 难伺候 = hard to please.

m: Your **heart** **hurts** for someone: to **love dearly**, feel sorry for.
ex: 看到孩子哭，妈妈很心疼。
Seeing the child cry, Mum felt for him.
花这么多钱，我真心疼。
I hate spending so much money.
use: Also used for regretting money or waste.

ex: 这个工作耗费了很多时间。
This work took up a lot of time.
不要耗费太多精力在小事上。
Don't waste too much energy on small things.
员工必须遵守公司的规章。
Staff must follow company regulations.
学校的规章制度很严格。
The school's rules are very strict.
人们开始觉醒了。
People have begun to wake up.
这本书让他觉醒了。
This book opened his eyes.
他经不住金钱的诱惑。
He couldn't resist the lure of money.
蛋糕对我来说太有诱惑力了。
Cake is far too tempting for me.
他恭敬地向老师鞠了一躬。
He bowed respectfully to the teacher.
孩子们对老人很恭敬。
The children are very respectful to the elderly.
这件事你要慎重考虑。
Think this over carefully.
他做决定一向很慎重。
He is always careful when making decisions.
我推测他已经走了。
I reckon he's already left.
这只是你的推测。
That's just your speculation.
他摔倒后失去了知觉。
He lost consciousness after the fall.
我的手冻得没有知觉了。
My hands are so cold they've gone numb.
我们两个人谈得很投机。
We two hit it off.
他靠投机赚了很多钱。
He made a lot of money speculating.
use: 谈得投机 = get along well in talk.

ex: 这个枕头太高了。
This pillow is too high.
我睡觉要用两个枕头。
I need two pillows to sleep.
use: Measure word 个; 头 is neutral tone.

ex: 公司雇佣了很多年轻人。
The company employs many young people.
他们雇佣了一名司机。
They hired a driver.
他住在一间小公寓里。
He lives in a small apartment.
这栋公寓有二十层。
This apartment block has twenty floors.
use: Measure word 套 or 间 (a unit), 栋 (building).

ex: 大家都来了，唯独他没来。
Everyone came except him.
我什么都吃，唯独不吃辣。
I eat everything, except spicy food.

m: Both characters live only in this word: to **pace back and forth**, to **hesitate**.
ex: 他在门口徘徊了很久。
He paced back and forth at the door for a long time.
气温在零度左右徘徊。
The temperature hovers around zero.
use: Also numbers hovering around a level.

ex: 我的自行车需要修理。
My bike needs repairing.
他会修理电脑。
He can repair computers.
use: 修 alone is common in speech.

ex: 我们应该反思自己的错误。
We should reflect on our mistakes.
这件事值得我们反思。
This is something we should reflect on.
你的担心是多余的。
Your worry is unnecessary.
把多余的东西扔了吧。
Throw away the stuff you don't need.
